items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I had this discussion with Delaney

ctx.x: So we can end it up. You're going to stick with it. Your kind of music till the end, right?

So when I told her, I had this discussion with Delaney and so forth and so on, and it encouraged me to go back to where I started from. Because as Louis Armstrong said about rock and roll, rock and roll is an old soup boil over, and which is the truth. And people say it's modern. Jazz is the only modern music. But you can't explain it to the people. They say Charlie Parker was great. I listened to one concert he gave in Paris, and he played T for Two, which I know Avery called it, and I know the tune very well.…
Yeah. Well, I don't think we'll ever understand that. I just think we're going to go on with it.
